title: The Open Door
fictionalSymbolism: There are more options than one frightened moment reveals.
groundedMantra: I preserve my choices, one step at a time.
nextAction: Identify one source of support or practical alternative.

title: The Available Tools
fictionalSymbolism: A desk contains one useful tool among several ceremonial ones.
groundedMantra: I begin with the resources I have.
nextAction: Choose one available resource for the next concrete step.

title: The Closed Portal
fictionalSymbolism: The meeting ends; the imaginary meeting need not continue.
groundedMantra: I close this thought and keep my next step.
nextAction: Use Observer Mode and finish.

title: The Scope Garden
fictionalSymbolism: Every new seed arrives with another watering obligation.
groundedMantra: My ideas have room within my actual capacity.
nextAction: Ask what capacity supports the new request.

title: The Royal We
fictionalSymbolism: The chorus speaks. Its membership remains unconfirmed.
groundedMantra: I ask for specifics behind a collective claim.
nextAction: Request one specific example and decision owner.

title: The Tiny Crown
fictionalSymbolism: The title is large. The evidence is small.
groundedMantra: My judgment stays mine beside this tiny crown.
nextAction: Ask for measurable requirements.

title: The Competing Yeses
fictionalSymbolism: Two invitations reach for the same hour.
groundedMantra: I choose a priority and acknowledge its trade-off.
nextAction: Ask which commitment takes priority.

title: The Overgrown Process
fictionalSymbolism: A checklist has grown a kingdom of its own.
groundedMantra: I look for the decision beneath the process.
nextAction: Ask which outcome the next step serves.

title: The Quiet Spine
fictionalSymbolism: A small chair supports a remarkably upright spine.
groundedMantra: My limit stands without a dramatic entrance.
nextAction: Choose one limit you can state plainly.

title: The Witness
fictionalSymbolism: A quiet notebook separates memory from interpretation.
groundedMantra: I trust my observations without inventing an explanation.
nextAction: Write an observable fact and one follow-up.

title: The Meeting Ouroboros
fictionalSymbolism: A meeting eats its minutes and summons a younger meeting.
groundedMantra: My time has value beyond the calendar.
nextAction: Ask for a decision, owner and deadline.

title: The Inquisition
fictionalSymbolism: Every answer produces a new question and no stated allegation.
groundedMantra: I return to the specific question.
nextAction: Ask what single factual question needs resolution.

title: The Pending Approval
fictionalSymbolism: A document hangs upside down beneath an approval stamp.
groundedMantra: I recognize a blocked decision as a dependency.
nextAction: Identify the decision and the person authorized to make it.

title: The Archive
fictionalSymbolism: A closed folder makes room for a blank page.
groundedMantra: I release the task that no longer serves its purpose.
nextAction: Ask whether the superseded requirement can be retired.

title: The Measured Pour
fictionalSymbolism: Two mugs exchange coffee without inventing a larger mug.
groundedMantra: My capacity stays finite as requests grow.
nextAction: Check the scope against available time.

title: The Golden Handcuffs
fictionalSymbolism: Coin and fear sit together on the same velvet cushion.
groundedMantra: My income matters. My judgment remains mine.
nextAction: Identify one practical step that protects your options.

title: The Shifting Altar
fictionalSymbolism: The standard moves after the offering is delivered.
groundedMantra: I name a change without making it my failure.
nextAction: Compare previous and new acceptance criteria.

title: The Single Clear Signal
fictionalSymbolism: One lamp survives a constellation of notification badges.
groundedMantra: I begin with one clear next step.
nextAction: Name the smallest useful action.

title: The Paper Moon
fictionalSymbolism: A warning casts a shadow larger than the available evidence.
groundedMantra: I feel fear and check the facts.
nextAction: Differentiate the exact statement from your feared outcome.

title: The Plain Facts
fictionalSymbolism: A desk lamp illuminates a short list without a dramatic soundtrack.
groundedMantra: I start with what I can verify.
nextAction: Separate a confirmed fact from an assumption.

title: The Whispering Tower
fictionalSymbolism: Absent coworkers are quoted by a mysterious messenger.
groundedMantra: I build my view of colleagues through direct experience.
nextAction: Avoid gossip and focus on observable work.

title: The Closed Loop
fictionalSymbolism: A final checkbox closes a circle of wandering arrows.
groundedMantra: I give this finished step a stopping point.
nextAction: Write what is complete and what remains open.

title: Ace of Cups
fictionalSymbolism: A single cup leaves room for an honest feeling.
groundedMantra: I let a feeling exist without letting it write my reply.
nextAction: Name your feeling privately before choosing your words.

title: Two of Cups
fictionalSymbolism: Two cups share a table without becoming one cup.
groundedMantra: I cooperate without giving up my own needs.
nextAction: State one practical need in the conversation.

title: Three of Cups
fictionalSymbolism: Three cups gather around a completed piece of work.
groundedMantra: I acknowledge my contribution in plain words.
nextAction: Name one specific contribution you can verify.

title: Four of Cups
fictionalSymbolism: A fourth invitation waits beside three full cups.
groundedMantra: I recognize the work already filling my capacity.
nextAction: Check whether the additional commitment is feasible.

title: Five of Cups
fictionalSymbolism: Two standing cups remain beside three spilled plans.
groundedMantra: I face this outcome without erasing my options.
nextAction: List one option that remains available.

title: Six of Cups
fictionalSymbolism: An old mug returns with an old expectation attached.
groundedMantra: I look at this familiar pattern with fresh attention.
nextAction: Compare the present request with what was actually said.

title: Seven of Cups
fictionalSymbolism: Seven attractive cups conceal seven different definitions of done.
groundedMantra: I check the requirements behind a promising offer.
nextAction: Ask what a successful result would look like.

title: Eight of Cups
fictionalSymbolism: Eight abandoned mugs mark a route out of an unproductive exchange.
groundedMantra: I step back from a conversation going in circles.
nextAction: Choose a professional way to pause or reschedule.

title: Nine of Cups
fictionalSymbolism: Nine cups wait while the owner chooses what is enough.
groundedMantra: I recognize enough when the agreed work is done.
nextAction: Write one condition that would make this step complete.

title: Ten of Cups
fictionalSymbolism: Ten cups form a team without appointing a family patriarch.
groundedMantra: My work relationships have professional limits.
nextAction: Describe the work need without a loyalty argument.

title: Page of Cups
fictionalSymbolism: A small messenger offers a feeling without a performance review.
groundedMantra: My feelings are not a rating of my competence.
nextAction: Separate a feeling from a factual work issue.

title: Knight of Cups
fictionalSymbolism: A persuasive invitation arrives wearing an excellent metaphor.
groundedMantra: I keep warm language separate from agreed scope.
nextAction: Check the practical commitment behind the invitation.

title: Queen of Cups
fictionalSymbolism: A careful listener keeps one cup for their own needs.
groundedMantra: I include myself in the care I offer.
nextAction: Identify what you need after this interaction.

title: King of Cups
fictionalSymbolism: A steady hand holds a cup while the meeting grows theatrical.
groundedMantra: I choose a measured sentence with unsettled feelings beside me.
nextAction: Use one factual sentence and a clear request.

title: Ace of Pentacles
fictionalSymbolism: One usable resource interrupts an elaborate funding ritual.
groundedMantra: I count the resources I actually have.
nextAction: Confirm which resource is actually available.

title: Two of Pentacles
fictionalSymbolism: Two budgets balance on one working afternoon.
groundedMantra: My time belongs in the resource calculation.
nextAction: Compare the request with your existing commitments.

title: Three of Pentacles
fictionalSymbolism: Three craftspeople inspect one shared definition of done.
groundedMantra: I deserve a visible standard for this work.
nextAction: Agree which criterion the team will use.

title: Four of Pentacles
fictionalSymbolism: Four locked drawers protect resources nobody can access.
groundedMantra: I recognize access as a requirement for delivery.
nextAction: Ask for the access needed to do the work.

title: Five of Pentacles
fictionalSymbolism: Five expenses wait outside an approved budget.
groundedMantra: I bring the missing resource into the discussion.
nextAction: Name the resource gap without inventing a solution.

title: Six of Pentacles
fictionalSymbolism: Six coins move across a table with no hidden receipt.
groundedMantra: I consider the conditions attached to an offer.
nextAction: Ask what the offered support includes.

title: Seven of Pentacles
fictionalSymbolism: Seven seeds wait beside a progress report that says soon.
groundedMantra: I review progress without promising an outcome.
nextAction: Check what has changed since the last review.

title: Eight of Pentacles
fictionalSymbolism: Eight deliberate repetitions improve one observable skill.
groundedMantra: I practice a skill without making perfection my entry fee.
nextAction: Choose one concrete part of the task to practice.

title: Nine of Pentacles
fictionalSymbolism: Nine tools rest on a desk with a visible closing time.
groundedMantra: My competence exists beyond constant availability.
nextAction: Choose a stopping point for this piece of work.

title: Ten of Pentacles
fictionalSymbolism: Ten folders contain a process that can outlive one person.
groundedMantra: I value a clear agreement beyond uncertain memory.
nextAction: Write down the confirmed part of the process.

title: Page of Pentacles
fictionalSymbolism: A small notebook records the first confirmed requirement.
groundedMantra: I begin learning from what I know.
nextAction: Separate a confirmed requirement from a useful question.

title: Knight of Pentacles
fictionalSymbolism: A patient worker follows the checklist without worshipping it.
groundedMantra: I keep what works and question what obstructs it.
nextAction: Review whether the checklist still serves the outcome.

title: Queen of Pentacles
fictionalSymbolism: A maintained desk contains room for actual work.
groundedMantra: My support is practical and bounded.
nextAction: Identify one resource that would make the task feasible.

title: King of Pentacles
fictionalSymbolism: A solid chair holds a budget with clearly named limits.
groundedMantra: I notice the resource limit beneath the impressive title.
nextAction: Ask what authority and resources support the decision.

title: Ace of Swords
fictionalSymbolism: One clean question cuts a knot of assumptions.
groundedMantra: I start with one question that matters.
nextAction: Ask which outcome needs to change.

title: Two of Swords
fictionalSymbolism: Two equally urgent emails share a single subject line.
groundedMantra: I hold competing instructions up to a real priority.
nextAction: Ask which instruction takes precedence.

title: Three of Swords
fictionalSymbolism: Three comments pierce the same unfinished draft.
groundedMantra: My worth stays separate from this feedback.
nextAction: Request one concrete example of the change needed.

title: Four of Swords
fictionalSymbolism: Four swords rest beside an unanswered message.
groundedMantra: I give my answer a moment to form.
nextAction: Check when a response is actually required.

title: Five of Swords
fictionalSymbolism: A victorious reply has somehow created three more arguments.
groundedMantra: I choose my goal beyond winning the wording.
nextAction: Decide which practical outcome matters here.

title: Six of Swords
fictionalSymbolism: A small boat carries six revised documents away from the old brief.
groundedMantra: I move through a change without naming myself a failure.
nextAction: Confirm which version is now authoritative.

title: Seven of Swords
fictionalSymbolism: Seven carefully phrased sentences obscure a missing fact.
groundedMantra: I look for information behind the polished sentence.
nextAction: Ask for the fact the discussion still needs.

title: Eight of Swords
fictionalSymbolism: Eight comment boxes leave one narrow path through the page.
groundedMantra: I identify the actual constraint within this noise.
nextAction: Name one constraint you can verify.

title: Nine of Swords
fictionalSymbolism: Nine imaginary replies hover above an unsent draft.
groundedMantra: I let an imagined conversation pass without rehearsing it.
nextAction: Keep one short professional response.

title: Ten of Swords
fictionalSymbolism: Ten revisions land on a document whose purpose has changed.
groundedMantra: I check whether this work still serves its purpose.
nextAction: Ask whether the original deliverable is still needed.

title: Page of Swords
fictionalSymbolism: A new messenger carries a question without a verdict.
groundedMantra: I stay curious without pretending to know.
nextAction: Ask for the term or expectation that remains unclear.

title: Knight of Swords
fictionalSymbolism: A fast reply gallops past the actual question.
groundedMantra: I give accuracy a place beside speed.
nextAction: Read the exact request before answering.

title: Queen of Swords
fictionalSymbolism: A clear editor removes three unnecessary defenses.
groundedMantra: My boundary is brief and specific.
nextAction: Remove one sentence of over-explanation.

title: King of Swords
fictionalSymbolism: A chair of authority holds a written criterion rather than a raised voice.
groundedMantra: I ask for a standard I can work with.
nextAction: Request the criterion used to assess the work.

title: Ace of Wands
fictionalSymbolism: One new idea arrives before its project code.
groundedMantra: I keep my interest separate from a promise.
nextAction: Ask what the proposed first step requires.

title: Two of Wands
fictionalSymbolism: Two routes begin from the same crowded desk.
groundedMantra: I consider the trade-off inside this choice.
nextAction: Compare the effort and purpose of the two options.

title: Three of Wands
fictionalSymbolism: Three signposts point beyond the current sprint.
groundedMantra: I look ahead without inventing the missing deadline.
nextAction: Ask which future milestone is confirmed.

title: Four of Wands
fictionalSymbolism: Four posts hold a small shelter around completed work.
groundedMantra: I recognize an agreement when its terms are clear.
nextAction: Record the confirmed scope and any open question.

title: Five of Wands
fictionalSymbolism: Five presenters compete for one screen share.
groundedMantra: I distinguish a roomful of opinions from a decision.
nextAction: Ask who will decide and what they need to decide.

title: Six of Wands
fictionalSymbolism: Six banners celebrate a result before the notes are written.
groundedMantra: I accept recognition without turning it into a new obligation.
nextAction: Record the result and the contributions you know.

title: Seven of Wands
fictionalSymbolism: Seven requests arrive at one carefully drawn line.
groundedMantra: My capacity stays the same when the request repeats.
nextAction: Restate one limit and the available alternative.

title: Eight of Wands
fictionalSymbolism: Eight messages travel faster than the brief.
groundedMantra: I find the instruction beneath the busy channel.
nextAction: Ask for the current requirement in one place.

title: Nine of Wands
fictionalSymbolism: Nine posts surround a desk that has seen several revisions.
groundedMantra: My past effort does not sign away my future time.
nextAction: Check what support the next step needs.

title: Ten of Wands
fictionalSymbolism: Ten wands fit poorly inside one job description.
groundedMantra: I see a workload made of specific commitments.
nextAction: Ask which existing task should move if this is added.

title: Page of Wands
fictionalSymbolism: A new project carries a blank assumptions section.
groundedMantra: I begin with a beginner's right to ask.
nextAction: Write one question before agreeing to the task.

title: Knight of Wands
fictionalSymbolism: An energetic proposal outruns its list of dependencies.
groundedMantra: I notice the dependency even when momentum is loud.
nextAction: Identify the approval or input the plan needs.

title: Queen of Wands
fictionalSymbolism: A bright lamp makes the scope visible rather than larger.
groundedMantra: My confidence has room for a practical limit.
nextAction: Say what you can offer and what remains outside scope.

title: King of Wands
fictionalSymbolism: A large plan stands beside a small acceptance checklist.
groundedMantra: I look for an outcome inside the direction.
nextAction: Ask for the result, owner and acceptance criteria.
